Established in 2010, ATME College of Engineering is proud to be recognized as a leading institution in the field of engineering education with markable milestones, including accreditation from NBA, NAAC A+ grade, QS-iGuage Gold Ranking, and receiving grants to the tune of Rs.300 lakhs from various funding agencies.

Why ATMECE ?

• Cutting-Edge Infrastructure • Support for Research & Innovation • Opportunities for Professional Development • Performance-Linked Incentives • Collaborative and Inclusive Environment • Opportunities for Impact and Contribution

We are now seeking exceptional faculty members in the following Programs to join our prestigious institution and be a part of our success story.

If you are an accomplished academician who is passionate about teaching, research, and innovation, and eager to be a part of a vibrant academic community, ATME College of Engineering is the place for you!

To apply, please submit your CV along with a cover letter highlighting your qualifications and accomplishments to careers@old.atme.edu.in. Join us in shaping the future of engineering education and research at ATME College of Engineering!

Send us your Resume

NOTE: Qualification and experience as per AICTE norms

Advertisement for Employment

Date: 28/06/2021

Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the posts of Project coordinator, Project Assistant and Field worker to work in Department of Science and Technology (DST) sponsored research project titled “Innovative ICT Enabled Co-working Community Center Design for Rural Development.” sanctioned for a period of three years.
Job Code Position Details
DSTP001 Project coordinator Click for Details
DSTP002 Project Assistant Click for Details
DSTP003 Field worker Click for Details
  Employment Conditions
  1. Age limit: Must not be over 32 years as date on advertisement.
  2. Employment Type: The position is purely temporary initially for one year and renewable each year subject to satisfactory performance up to for a maximum for three of three years
  Application on plain paper with complete resume along with self-attested photocopy of mark sheets, certificates and supporting documents SUPERSCRIBING THE JOBCODE should reach within 15 days from date of advertisement to the undersigned.   Dr. Mahesh P K, Professor and HOD, Department of Electronics and Communication, ATME College OF Engineering, 13th kilometer, Mysore-Kanakapura-Bangalore Road. Mysore. 570028, Karnataka / mahesh.k.devalapur@gmail.com / Dr.MaheshPK_EC@old.atme.edu.in[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
